name: @pete-life/billy-mcp

tools.name: billy_status
tools.description: Configuration and connection status. Never exposes credentials.

tools.name: billy_list
tools.description: List every page of a Billy resource. Default response is compact and complete; verbose returns sanitized detail. Unknown filters are rejected.

tools.name: billy_get
tools.description: Read a Billy record and optionally sideload relationships. Default response is compact; verbose returns sanitized detail.

tools.name: billy_period_overview
tools.description: Inventory unreconciled bank lines, existing postings, bills and collected receipts for a period. Candidate matches are suggestions, not an accounting verdict.

tools.name: billy_trial_balance
tools.description: Balances by live account through an inclusive posting entry date. Uses base currency and rejects FX postings without a base amount.

tools.name: billy_profit_loss
tools.description: Period P&L from non-voided postings. Defaults to live incomeStatement account natures, or accepts explicit reportType or revenue and expense account IDs; no chart numbers are assumed.

tools.name: billy_outstanding
tools.description: Current approved unpaid bills and invoices, grouped by original currency. Not a historical as-of report.

tools.name: billy_period_expenses
tools.description: Net expense postings on debit-normal accounts under a live account-nature reportType (default incomeStatement), optionally narrowed to selected expense account IDs; credits reduce expense.

tools.name: billy_import_receipt
tools.description: Archive an original PDF/PNG/JPEG from the configured inbox. Provide extracted invoice metadata and provenance from Gmail, Drive, local files or vendor portal. Same bytes are deduplicated. Does not upload to Billy.

tools.name: billy_receipts
tools.description: List locally archived supporting documents and their Billy attachment IDs.

tools.name: billy_save_vendor
tools.description: Store a vendor billing portal location and retrieval status. This registry guides the agent browser/connector; it does not log in itself. Never include secrets or session URLs.

tools.name: billy_vendors
tools.description: List vendor billing portals and access exceptions for receipt retrieval.

tools.name: billy_prepare
tools.description: Validate and persist a concrete write proposal without modifying Billy. Review the returned operation, reason, ID and hash. Receipts must be uploaded before preparing a booking. Reconciliation is restricted to matching existing bank-account postings.

paymentTermsDays.description: Net days from invoice entryDate; sets paymentTermsMode to net and verifies the computed dueDate

tools.name: billy_plan
tools.description: Inspect a saved proposal and its execution evidence. Default output retains operation, hash and snapshot hashes.

tools.name: billy_refresh_plan
tools.description: Refresh an unexecuted/rejected proposal after changed data or expiry; review it again before execution.

tools.name: billy_execute
tools.description: Execute the exact reviewed proposal once. Default approval uses the MCP client form; a supplied authorization note is only an audit assertion. Unknown outcomes block further writes.

tools.name: billy_batch_prepare
tools.description: Preflight and save an ordered purchase batch (1-10 cases). Each case binds an original receipt, exact draft lines and explicit approval/payment/reconciliation stages. No Billy writes.

tools.name: billy_batch_get
tools.description: Inspect saved batch, child plan IDs, partial progress and stop reason.

tools.name: billy_batch_refresh
tools.description: Refresh initial evidence for a batch before any stage starts; clears prior client approval.

tools.name: billy_batch_execute
tools.description: Approve the complete ordered company batch once and execute its stages sequentially through guarded plans. A stop returns explicit partial progress. Resume the same hash after inspecting the cause.

tools.name: billy_journal
tools.description: Read the last 200 proposals, including rejected/uncertain writes. An unknown outcome requires reconciliation against live Billy records before recovery.
